s_lib_test_mod.config.title: S-Lib Test Mod Config
s_lib_test_mod.category.synced.desc: Server-authoritative configuration managed by SyncedConfigManager. OVERRIDE_CLIENT options come from the server, INFORM_SERVER options are sent to it, and NONE options stay on this client.
The nested category visualSettings, shown with nested(). Its options depend on Test Boolean Toggle from the Synced Config tab.
s_lib_test_mod.category.enchantment_allo: One allowed list per enchantment, shown with nestedMapLists(). Outside a world on 1.21 and newer only the configured enchantments are listed.
The nested POJO list tooltipEntries, shown with nestedList().
s_lib_test_mod.category.local.desc: Local configuration managed by LocalConfigManager and generated with autoGenerate(). Every @Sync annotation is inert here.
s_lib_test_mod.group.primitives.desc: Basic primitive types, numeric boundaries (@Range annotations), sliders, @Format and enums.
s_lib_test_mod.group.adapters.desc: Adapters for AWT Color, Minecraft TextColor, Pattern, Identifier and UUID, plus a Vector3f registered by the screen.
s_lib_test_mod.group.collections.desc: Lists and maps of primitives and adapter types, without @Nest.
s_lib_test_mod.group.list_elements.desc: One element of a list shown as its own option with listElement().
s_lib_test_mod.group.network_modes.desc: Synchronization behaviors: OVERRIDE_CLIENT, INFORM_SERVER and local-only NONE.
s_lib_test_mod.group.enchantment_rules.d: A map from enchantment IDs to nested rule objects.
s_lib_test_mod.group.tooltip_entries.des: A list of nested tooltip entries with enums, colors and constraints.
s_lib_test_mod.description.color: AWT Color shared by Primary Color and Translucent Accent Color through @SharedDescription.
s_lib_test_mod.option.test_int.desc: Integer option clamped within range [-100 to 1000].
s_lib_test_mod.option.test_long.desc: Long integer option clamped within range [-10000 to 100000] with step 500.
s_lib_test_mod.option.test_float.desc: Floating-point option clamped within range [0.0 to 5.0].
s_lib_test_mod.option.test_double.desc: Double-precision option clamped within range [-50.0 to 50.0]. In the Synced Config tab it is enabled only while Test Enum Option is OPTION_A or OPTION_C.
s_lib_test_mod.option.slider_step005.des: Float slider [0.0 to 1.0] with a 0.05 step, shown with two decimals.
s_lib_test_mod.option.slider_step0002.de: Float slider [0.0 to 0.1] with a 0.002 step, shown with three decimals.
s_lib_test_mod.option.percentage.desc: Float slider [0 to 100] shown as a percentage through @Format.
s_lib_test_mod.option.test_boolean.desc: Basic boolean flag toggle. Enable HUD Overlay in Visual Settings depends on it.
s_lib_test_mod.option.test_string.desc: Standard string option. The synced config also reads it from the old key legacyString.
s_lib_test_mod.option.translucent_accent: AWT Color with alpha channel transparency (RGBA).
s_lib_test_mod.option.chat_highlight_col: Named Minecraft TextColor representing chat accent color.
s_lib_test_mod.option.custom_rgb_text_co: Minecraft TextColor represented in RGB hex.
Compiled regular expression pattern for filtering items.
s_lib_test_mod.option.favorite_weapon.de: Minecraft item identifier picked from the item dropdown, without tags.
s_lib_test_mod.option.sound_effect_id.de: Namespaced identifier for a sound event.
UUID representation string. The Synced Config tab disables it with configureOption(); the Local Config tab keeps it editable.
s_lib_test_mod.option.spawn_offset.desc: Vector3f written as x,y,z, through a controller the screen registers with registerAdapted().
s_lib_test_mod.option.first_status_indic: The first element of Status Indicators. Editing either one updates the other.
s_lib_test_mod.option.item_blacklist.des: List of blacklisted items, tags and wildcards.
s_lib_test_mod.option.translation_aliase: Key-value map of string aliases formatted as 'key: value'.
s_lib_test_mod.option.client_preferences: Client preference sent to the server via C2S packet (@Sync(INFORM_SERVER)). The Synced Config tab shows it as a dropdown.
s_lib_test_mod.option.server_informed_in: Client integer setting sent to the server via C2S packet [0 to 500].
Marked @Sync(OVERRIDE_CLIENT) in the local config to verify it stays inert and local.
s_lib_test_mod.option.local_client_toggl: Local-only toggle (@Sync(NONE)) kept on this client.
s_lib_test_mod.option.local_double.desc: Local-only double [0.5 to 1.5] kept on this client.
Enchantment IDs allowed to bypass normal restrictions.
Enchantment IDs explicitly restricted or forced incompatible.
Level multiplier limit for this enchantment [1 to 255].
Whether this enchantment bypasses vanilla incompatibility checks.
s_lib_test_mod.option.enchantment_allowe: Enchantment IDs allowed together with this enchantment.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltip_entries.co: Descriptive comment or label for this custom tooltip.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltip_entries.te: Lines of text rendered inside the custom tooltip.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltip_entries.po: Whether the lines go above (TOP) or below (BOTTOM) the vanilla lines.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltip_entries.ta: Item, tag or matcher (for example regex:) that receives this tooltip.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltip_entries.bo: Render the tooltip header line in bold font.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltip_entries.it: Render the tooltip text lines in italic font.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltip_entries.ba: Opacity of the tooltip background box [0 to 255].
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltip_entries.uu: Unique persistent identifier for this tooltip entry.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltip_entries.co: Border accent color formatted as hex RGB.
s_lib_test_mod.option.tooltip_entries.te: Minecraft text colors for gradient accents.
s_lib_test_mod.option.visual_settings.en: Toggle HUD overlay rendering. Enabled only while Test Boolean Toggle is on.
s_lib_test_mod.option.visual_settings.hu: HUD scale multiplier [1 to 5]. Enabled only while Enable HUD Overlay is on.
s_lib_test_mod.option.visual_settings.ov: Semi-transparent background color for the HUD overlay.
s_lib_test_mod.option.visual_settings.hu: Default text color for HUD widgets.
s_lib_test_mod.option.visual_settings.su: HUD element animation speed multiplier [0.1 to 10.0].
Name identifier of the visual theme profile.
Render wireframe bounds around HUD widgets for debugging.
